summary: Route staged REST PG&E MFA actions to an explicit named setup, reject ambiguous multi-setup requests, and map MFA precondition errors to the caller-correctable HTTP status.
reason: The REST compatibility handlers selected the first PG&E/Opower setup for every MFA action, which could apply a request to the wrong configured account after provider-state isolation was added; configured but unstarted/unselected MFA verification was also incorrectly reported as an upstream 502 failure.
validated_outcome: REST MFA start, selection, and verification use the requested PG&E/Opower setup; multi-setup requests without a selector fail closed while the single-setup compatibility path remains available; and configured MFA transition preconditions return HTTP 409 rather than an upstream failure.
